step1_analysis.description: A basic common-source (originally common-emitter) amplifier with resistive shunt feedback. The feedback resistor provides wideband input matching and flattens the gain response, serving as the core for a wideband LNA.

paper_reference.title: A 3–10-GHz Low-Noise Amplifier With Wideband LC-Ladder Matching Network

voltage_gain.description: Maximum AC voltage gain from the source to the output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ≈ gm * (RL || RF). For Id ≈ 10mA, gm ≈ 40mS. With RL=500Ω and RF=10kΩ, Gain ≈ 40mS * 476Ω ≈ 19 V/V ≈ 25 dB. Actual gain will be lower due to RS and feedback loading.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 NMOS characteristics and simplified resistive loading instead of the paper's LC-ladder matching.

bandwidth_3db.description: The frequency at which the voltage gain drops by 3 dB from its maximum value.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW ≈ 1 / (2 * π * R_out * C_out). C_out is dominated by Cgd (Miller multiplied) and Cdb. For W=50µm, C_out ≈ 100fF. BW ≈ 1 / (2 * π * 500Ω * 100fF) ≈ 3.18 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without the LC-ladder peaking network described in the paper, the bandwidth is limited by the simple RC time constant of the drain node.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the amplifier from the supply.

paper_reported.value: 10 mA bias current (approx 18-33 mW depending on VDD)

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_VDD. Assuming VDD = 1.8V and targeting the paper's 10mA bias current, Power = 1.8V * 10mA = 18mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly derived from the paper's reported bias current scaled to the standard 1.8V supply of SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power consumption, AC voltage gain, and -3dB bandwidth of the simplified shunt-feedback LNA core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Shunt-Feedback LNA Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameters
.param W_m1=50 L_m1=0.15
.param R_f=10k R_s=50 R_l=500

* Circuit Netlist (Adapted for SKY130 NMOS)
RF VO N1 {R_f}
RS VS N1 {R_s}
M1 VO N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_m1} L={L_m1}
RL VCC VO {R_l}

* Sources
VS VS GND DC 0.9 AC 1
VCC VCC GND DC 1.8

* Control Block
.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VCC) * 1.8
  print power
  
  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(VO)
  
  * Measure Maximum Gain
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  
  * Measure -3dB Bandwidth
  let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
